event_name: Time 18:18 2018 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 20 collided with car 10 at turn 20.
incident_time: Penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 8 points in total for the 12 month period)
offence: Causing a collision in breach of Article 2d of Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and the driver of car 20 caused a collision with car 10. The driver of car 20 moved unpredictably and unnecessarily to the left and collided with car 10 which was maintaining its direction. The Stewards determined that the driver of car 20 was wholly to blame for the collision. Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Tom Kristensen Anar Shukurov
title: 2018 Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018 Offence Car 20 Causing A Collision With Car 10 Doc 43
